text_en: John went up from Gazara and reported to his father Simon what Cendebeus had done.
text_cn: 若望由革则尔上来，将耕德巴所作的事，报告给父亲息孟；

text_en: And Simon called in his two eldest sons Judas and John, and said to them: “My brothers and I and my father’s house have fought the wars of Israel from our youth until this day, and things have prospered in our hands so that we have delivered Israel many times.
text_cn: 息孟就叫来自己的两个大儿子犹大和若望，向他们说：“我与我的兄弟和我父的全家，从幼年一直到今天，攻打了以色列的仇人，事在我们手里很顺利，因此我们屡次拯救了以色列。

text_en: But now I have grown old, and you by Heaven’s mercy are mature in years. Take my place and my brother’s, and go out and fight for our nation, and may the help that comes from Heaven be with you. ”
text_cn: 现在我老了，因上天的仁慈， 你们正在壮年，你们要代替我和我的兄弟，出去为我们的民族作战，愿上天的助佑常与你们同在。”

text_en: So John chose out of the country twenty thousand warriors and cavalry, and they marched against Cendebeus and camped for the night in Modein.
text_cn: 息孟从国中选出两万步兵和骑兵，便向耕德巴进军，当晚在摩丁过宿。

text_en: Early in the morning they started out and marched into the plain, where a large force of infantry and cavalry was coming to meet them; and a stream lay between them.
text_cn: 清早起来，进军平原时，看，有一大队步兵和骑兵与他们相遇，双方之间，只隔着一条小河。

text_en: Then he and his army lined up against them. He saw that the soldiers were afraid to cross the stream, so he crossed over first; and when his troops saw him, they crossed over after him.
text_cn: 若望与部队遂面对敌人扎营。他见部队不敢过河，就自己先过去，众人见他如此，也就随着他过去。

text_en: Then he divided the army and placed the cavalry in the center of the infantry, for the cavalry of the enemy were very numerous.
text_cn: 他把部队分开，将骑兵分布在步兵中间，因为敌人的骑兵非常多。

text_en: They sounded the trumpets, and Cendebeus and his army were put to flight; many of them fell wounded and the rest fled into the stronghold.
text_cn: 号角一响，一起进攻，耕德巴和他的军队败退，伤亡甚众，剩下的便逃到堡垒里。

text_en: At that time Judas the brother of John was wounded, but John pursued them until Cendebeus reached Kedron, which he had built.
text_cn: 那时，若望因哥哥犹大受了伤，就去追赶他们，一直追到耕德巴修建的克德龙。

text_en: They also fled into the towers that were in the fields of Azotus, and John burned it with fire, and about two thousand of them fell. He then returned to Judea safely.
text_cn: 还有些敌人逃到阿左托田野间的碉楼里去，若望放火将它烧了，敌军大约死了两千人，然后若望平安回到犹太。

text_en: Now Ptolemy son of Abubus had been appointed governor over the plain of Jericho; he had a large store of silver and gold,
text_cn: 阿步波的儿子仆托肋米，受任为耶里哥平原的总督，他金银很多，

text_en: for he was son-in-law of the high priest.
text_cn: 因为他是大司祭的女婿。

text_en: His heart was lifted up; he determined to get control of the country, and made treacherous plans against Simon and his sons, to do away with them.
text_cn: 这人心高气傲，想作全国之主，企图用诡计陷害息孟和他的儿子们，将他们除掉。

text_en: Now Simon was visiting the towns of the country and attending to their needs, and he went down to Jericho with his sons Mattathias and Judas, in the one hundred seventy-seventh year, in the eleventh month, which is the month of Shebat.
text_cn: 那时，息孟正在出巡全国各城，料理各城的事务；一百七十七年十一月，即“舍巴特”月， 息孟与他的儿子玛塔提雅和犹大下去，到了耶里哥。

text_en: The son of Abubus received them treacherously in the little stronghold called Dok, which he had built; he gave them a great banquet, and hid men there.
text_cn: 阿步波的儿子，便用诡计将他们接到自己建造而名叫多克的小堡垒里，给他们大摆盛筵，并在那里埋伏下一些人。

text_en: When Simon and his sons were drunk, Ptolemy and his men rose up, took their weapons, rushed in against Simon in the banquet hall and killed him and his two sons, as well as some of his servants.
text_cn: 当息孟和他的儿子们都喝醉时，仆托肋米同部下起来，拿着武器，进了餐厅，冲向息孟，就将他与他的两个儿子，以及他的几个侍从都杀了。

text_en: So he committed an act of great treachery and returned evil for good.
text_cn: 他作这严重背信负义的事，实在是以恶报善。

text_en: Then Ptolemy wrote a report about these things and sent it to the king, asking him to send troops to aid him and to turn over to him the towns and the country.
text_cn: 于是，仆托肋米写信将这事呈报给国王，以便给他派兵前来助战，好将他们的国土和城邑，交给国王。

text_en: He sent other troops to Gazara to do away with John; he sent letters to the captains asking them to come to him so that he might give them silver and gold and gifts;
text_cn: 他另派人到革则尔去杀害若望；又给千夫长去信，叫他们来归顺自己，也送给他们金银和礼物。

text_en: and he sent other troops to take possession of Jerusalem and the temple hill.
text_cn: 又派人去占领耶路撒冷和圣殿山。

text_en: But someone ran ahead and reported to John at Gazara that his father and brothers had perished, and that “he has sent men to kill you also. ”
text_cn: 但是，早已有人先到了革则尔，把他父亲和兄弟被杀的消息，报告给若望，而且还说：“他还派人来杀害你。”

text_en: When he heard this, he was greatly shocked; he seized the men who came to destroy him and killed them, for he had found out that they were seeking to destroy him.
text_cn: 若望听后大惊，便捉住来杀害他的人，将他们杀了，因为他已经知道他们图谋杀害他。

text_en: The rest of the acts of John and his wars and the brave deeds that he did, and the building of the walls that he completed, and his achievements,
text_cn: 若望其余的言行、战功，所行的英勇事迹，修筑的城垣（yuán），以及他的所作所为，

text_en: are written in the annals of his high priesthood, from the time that he became high priest after his father.
text_cn: 都记载在他承继他父亲为大司祭后，任大司祭的《年鉴》上。
